mentions.name: The Resume Chef
mentions.description: A free, private web-based resume builder with 10 templates to choose from. Finished resumes can be exported as PDF or stored as JSON on Google Drive or Dropbox, with no paywalls or monthly subscriptions.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of always having to update his wife's and family members' résumés.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got tired of always having to update my wife, and my family members résumés. So I created https://theresumechef.com
